blocks.title: Welcome to Probability
blocks.body: Before we dive in, let's look at a real-life example of this concept.
blocks.body_hi: इससे पहले कि हम शुरू करें, आइए इस अवधारणा का एक वास्तविक जीवन उदाहरण देखें।

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.body: A card is drawn from a well-shuffled deck of 52 cards. Find the probability of drawing a king.
blocks.body_hi: A card is drawn from a well-shuffled deck of 52 cards. Find the probability of drawing a king.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.body: A card is drawn from a deck of 52. Find the probability of drawing a red face card (jack, queen, king of hearts/diamonds).
blocks.body_hi: A card is drawn from a deck of 52. Find the probability of drawing a red face card (jack, queen, king of hearts/diamonds).

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.body: A bag has 5 white, 4 red, 3 black balls. Find the probability of drawing a white or red ball.
blocks.body_hi: A bag has 5 white, 4 red, 3 black balls. Find the probability of drawing a white or red ball.
